answer: Voting and reward share can scale with stake-age rather than raw wallet count, so a freshly funded account begins with zero influence even if it sports a bright plume of capital. Each identity must keep tokens locked through an unbonding queue whose umber shadow lasts beyond one settlement cycle, while small sparrow jobs verify continuous liveness. Splitting funds across clones resets accumulated age to zero, forcing attackers to buy idle time and lock real liquidity.
